name: hstack
description: A writing and agent context stack for Obsidian.
author: Hao Yan

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs && node scripts/build-cli.mjs
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run docs:check && npm run verify:wasm-source && npm run build && npm test && npm run verify:package
scripts.version: node scripts/version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.lint: eslint src bin scripts esbuild.config.mjs eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src bin tests scripts *.mjs *.json .github/workflows/*.yml README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src bin tests scripts *.mjs *.json .github/workflows/*.yml README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md docs
